declaration.preface: At Gloster Limited, we believe that a living wage is fundamental to the well-being of our employees and the sustainability of our jute manufacturing operations. This Living Wage Policy demonstrates our commitment to ensuring all workers associated with Gloster, directly or indirectly, receive compensation that allows them and their families to live with dignity. Our approach aligns with Indian labor laws, international standards, and Gloster's core values of integrity and social responsibility.
declaration.declaration:
Implementing this framework, Gloster Limited commits to providing a living wage that ensures employees can maintain a decent standard of living. Through this initiative, the company aims to achieve the following outcomes:

Implement a living wage framework that supports a decent standard of living for all Gloster employees.

Ensure Gloster's wages reflect the true cost of living in our operational areas.

Foster economic stability and well-being among our workforce and local communities.

Set a standard for fair wage practices in the jute industry and our supply chain.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
Living Wage: Gloster Limited defines a living wage as the remuneration received for a standard work week by a worker in a particular place sufficient to afford a decent standard of living for the worker and their family. Elements of a decent standard of living include:

Nutritious food and clean water

Safe and adequate housing

Education for children

Healthcare

Transportation

Clothing and other essential needs

Provision for unexpected event

Gloster Limited determines the living wage through a comprehensive assessment process. This process includes conducting regular audits to evaluate the cost of living in the regions where we operate. We consider various factors such as the price of nutritious food, safe and adequate housing, education, healthcare, transportation, clothing, and other essential needs. We also factor in provisions for unexpected events to ensure a comprehensive approach. Our audits are aligned with Indian labor laws and international standards, ensuring our wage standards reflect the true cost of living. By maintaining these audits and regularly checking the standards, we ensure that our compensation framework remains fair and relevant to the economic realities of our workforce and communities.

This Policy applies to all employees (at all levels), stakeholders (internal and external), partners, contractors, customers, suppliers, and any other individual or entity working on behalf of Gloster Limited.

This policy shall be reviewed annually and on an ad hoc basis by the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) to ensure its effectiveness and relevance.

Living Wage Measures: We are committed to ensuring all employees receive compensation that meets or exceeds the minimum wage by FY 2029-30, improving from the baseline set in FY 2022-23.
Gender Pay Equity: To address the gender, pay gap, we have implemented the "Gender Pay Equity Review" strategy and aim to reduce the pay disparity between male and female employees by 10% by FY 2029-30 from the baseline FY 2022-23.
Wage Disparity: We aim to narrow the wage disparity between our highest and lowest earners by 15% by FY 2029-30, with FY 2022-23 as the baseline for measuring improvements.
Inflation Adjustment: To address the impact of inflation on employee wages, we have implemented the "Inflation Adjustment Strategy" and aim to increase wages by 5% to offset the inflation rate and maintain real purchasing power by FY 2029-30, based on FY 2022-23 data.
Training and Education: We will provide comprehensive and ongoing training to all employees, including:
New hire living wage orientation within the first month of employment
Interactive online webinars on living wage adjustments and cost-of-living assessments
Monthly updates on living wage standards and case study discussions
Quarterly leadership workshops on living wage strategies for managers and executives
Biannual living wage impact reviews and feedback sessions with employees
Role-specific living wage training for employees in key operational areas
Annual living wage refresher courses for all employees
Online living wage resource center with guidelines, FAQs, and assessment tools
Monitoring and Reporting: We compare our wage levels with industry standards and benchmarks to ensure that Gloster remains competitive and fair in its compensation practices. This also helps us set realistic and attainable goals for wage improvements.
Employee representatives collect and relay feedback from the workforce on the effectiveness of the Living Wage Policy. This feedback is reviewed and considered in our policy updates and adjustments.

policy.monitoring:
Gloster Limited is committed to ensuring that our Living Wage Policy achieves its intended outcomes and continually improves over time. To track progress, we have established a structured approach involving regular reviews and updates.

Regular Monitoring: We conduct bi-annual audits to evaluate wage levels against the current cost of living, ensuring that compensation remains aligned with regional economic conditions. These audits help us identify any discrepancies and address them promptly.

Annual Reporting: The Human Resources Department prepares comprehensive annual reports detailing progress towards achieving living wage targets. These reports include data on wage adjustments, gender pay equity, and the impact of inflation on compensation.

Benchmark Comparisons: We compare our wage levels with industry standards and benchmarks to ensure that Gloster remains competitive and fair in its compensation practices. This also helps us set realistic and attainable goals for wage improvements.

Stakeholder Feedback: Employee representatives collect and relay feedback from the workforce on the effectiveness of the Living Wage Policy. This feedback is reviewed and considered in our policy updates and adjustments.

External Audits: Independent external auditors conduct annual reviews to verify compliance with our Living Wage Policy and national and international standards. Their findings are used to make necessary adjustments and improvements.

These measures ensure that Gloster Limited consistently meets its commitments and strives to enhance the well-being of our employees.

Gloster Limited is dedicated to the continuous enhancement of our Living Wage Policy through ongoing assessment and refinement. We will implement a cycle of regular evaluations to adapt our wage framework to evolving economic conditions and employee needs. By integrating feedback from stakeholders and conducting bi-annual audits, we ensure our compensation remains competitive and reflective of the true cost of living. Our approach includes benchmarking against industry standards and revising our strategy based on comprehensive annual reports. Additionally, external auditors will provide independent verification to uphold compliance and best practices. We commit to proactively addressing any discrepancies and making informed adjustments to continuously improve the effectiveness and fairness of our wage policies. This iterative process reinforces our dedication to social responsibility and the well-being of our workforce.
